rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a continent, though it can also mean mainland China from context.

example.english: Each continent has its own distinctive features.
example.traditional: 每一塊大陸都有自己嘅特色。
example.jyutping: mui5 jat1 faai3 daai6 luk6 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 dak6 sik1

rows.note: Use this mainly in geographic names and compounds such as 亞洲 or 歐洲, rather than as the default standalone word.

example.english: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
example.traditional: 亞洲係世界上最大嘅洲。
example.jyutping: aa3 zau1 hai6 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 zau1
